# iran.liveuamap.com

> > Live Universal Awareness Map tracking real-time conflict developments, military operations, and geopolitical events across Iran and the Middle East Gulf region.

iran.liveuamap.com provides live conflict mapping and breaking news coverage of the Iran-Israel military conflict and broader Middle East tensions, including casualty reports, airstrikes, and diplomatic statements. The platform offers both public live map access and premium API services for developers and analysts seeking GeoJSON-formatted conflict data.
